result:
Round 91 passed C and is published, and I've written round 92. The decision is **CONTINUE**. Nothing is blocked except the purchased-route mount, which the auth owner has to release. I changed no app source, and the store tree is still clean at `77cd5b6`.

**Round 91 result**
- C passed every row in a real browser, at both viewports, with 0 bugs.
- The WAV export memory fix worked: peak memory rose 529/543/531 MB against a 639 MB limit, down from 739–748 MB before. The new WAV + MP3 note and the MP3 timeout text are exact, and retrying after the timeout works without reloading the page.
- I closed GATE89-S2, GATE86-S2, R87-L-TIMEOUT-RELOAD-TEXT and GATE90-S6/S7.
- GATE90-S1 (memory kept after a cancel) did not reproduce: 26–29 MB retained, under the 58 MB rule, so no fix is scheduled. C's caveat is recorded: every cancel landed at 4% of the render.
- PROD-MP3-UNVERIFIED stays open. The gate-91 log again has only the build, no production MP3 run, so I've asked root to cover it in gate 92.
- SRW-20 is complete. Only the Tech Lead's manual browser checks R86-T to R91-T are left on it.

**Round 92 (D-29z57): SRW-21 stage 1, the part that doesn't need the protected route**
- **Why this next:** C has no open bugs, and SRW-21 comes next in dependency order. I put it ahead of the Lows batch because core scope comes before low-priority polish. The Lows-first order was B's own earlier choice, not the user's. I recorded that in D-29z57.
- **What I found in the code:** the backlog said the workspace would need no code change for a purchased mount. That's wrong. The heading, the badge ("demo collection — no sign-in needed"), the three load messages and the `czaba-studio-lab*` download names are all hardcoded. A purchased mount would tell buyers they're in a free demo.
- **What A builds:**
  - A new `app/lib/arrangement/collection.ts` with two pieces:
    - a text table that picks demo or purchased wording;
    - `createPurchasedWorkspaceCollection`, which checks its input, sorts stems by order, and sends no `Authorization` header. Error messages never include the URL or the token.
  - The workspace header, the load messages and the download names now depend on whether the collection is demo or purchased. `/studio-lab` output must stay byte-identical.
  - New tests PC1–PC9 and PW1–PW6, with eight mutation proofs; doc 079 status line, new doc 080, and a mount guide `docs/technical/arrangement-workspace.md`.
  - Expected end state: 3 modified and 5 new files; the other 513 tracked files are frozen.
- **What C checks in the browser:**
  - the demo wording exactly, at both viewports;
  - all three load messages, by holding back and blocking the demo audio requests;
  - the four demo download names;
  - network rules, hydration and purchase protection.
- **Purchased wording:** I picked the smallest honest wording: heading `CZABA Studio`, badge `შეძენილი კოლექცია` ("purchased collection"), and download names starting `czaba-studio`. The planned English-strings visual refresh will replace it later.
- **Purchased path is unit-tested only:** it can't be opened in a browser until the route is released. I added Tech Lead check R92-T for that point.

**Other updates**
- I sent root the formal checkpoint request for the export code structure (q14), in `b-round-91-checkpoint-request.md`. It doesn't block anything.
- New Lows: GATE91-S1 (the WAV + MP3 note is read out as part of the radio's name) and COLLECTION-EMPTY-STATUS (an empty collection would show "loading" forever). The reviewers' architecture notes are filed as backlog signals under q14, not as tasks.
- Round 93 will be the regression round if it's planned on or after 2026-10-24. Otherwise it's Lows batch part 1, then full regression, then T12, then the visual refresh. No scope was cut.

The advisor was available and I consulted it before writing and again at the end.
